patch.summary: Is Brevo worth it? Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) is a multi-channel marketing platform centered on email, with automation, SMS, chat, and CRM-lite tools. Pricing is primarily send-volume based (not contact-count for email), with a forever-free plan and Starter/Standard/Professiona…. Strong when SMBs wanting send-based email pricing with a generous free plan. Weak when Free plan daily send cap (300/day) constrains frequent campaigners.

sections.heading: Brevo: buy when the operating loop matches
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Commit when your weekly work needs email campaigns and SMBs wanting send-based email pricing with a generous free plan holds. Counter-signal: Walk when Free plan daily send cap (300/day) constrains frequent campaigners would block go-live.

Capability hinge for this product: email campaigns; newsletter builder; email templates; drag drop editor.

Integrations in research: Shopify, WordPress, Woocommerce.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Starter, Standard, Professional.

sections.heading: Who Brevo is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Brevo when send-based pricing, a generous free plan, and multi-channel SMB email are the priority..

Avoid if: Compare MailerLite for simpler free-tier ease, GetResponse for all-in-one free-tier automation/LPs, Klaviyo for ecommerce depth, and ActiveCampaign for automation+CRM depth..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with MailerLite on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Brevo price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
Prove one real workflow on the documented free/trial path before arguing for Starter.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Campaign/automation depth vs design simplicity.

Next step: run email campaigns end-to-end, then decide.
